title.zh: 统一退伍军人纪念医院官员与雇员薪金并为其提供资金的法案
title.en: An Act Standardizing the Salaries of Officials and Employees in the Veterans Memorial Hospital and Providing Funds Therefor.
title.orig: An Act Standardizing the Salaries of Officials and Employees in the Veterans Memorial Hospital and Providing Funds Therefor.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6542_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Other existing positions in the Veterans Memorial Hospital not mentioned in Section One of this Act, except casual and emergency positions shall be adjusted to the same range as the other positions of equal WAPCO range as of June 30, 1970, have been adjusted under this Act.

The incumbents of the positions at the time of approval of this Act, whose salaries are herein standardized shall be automatically be entitled to the benefits hereof without the need of another appointment.
In the implementation of the salary adjustment under this Act, the salary of an employee shall be place in the same step it had in its range as of June 30, 1970.

All funds needed for the implementation of the salary adjustments provided for in this Act shall be taken from the savings of Veterans Memorial Hospital appropriation. Thereafter, the sums shall be included in the annual general appropriation Acts.
Republic Act Numbered Five thousand two hundred five, as amended by Republic Act Six thousand one hundred thirty-three is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, August 26, 1972.
